items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I'm working in a show called 'Sons of Guns' with Jack Donahue and Lilly Damita

ctx.x: Well no, the top priced men of the band like Benny Goodman was, and Teagarden and myself. We were you know, like stars of the band. And we made plenty of money so I paid Bix back and everything was fine. Now we are coming to the Jimmy Plunket's, the speak easy. I'm now finished with Pollack's band, I'm working in a show called 'Sons of Guns' with Jack Donahue and Lilly Damita and I'm in the pit and I'm making $250 a week in the pit there and working
in pictures at Paramount Studios and making recordings, so I was probably making close to $500 a week.
